authored_by: R6 synthetic bilingual corpus-grounded questions; no human-certified service answers

protocol.positive_regression_guard: No previously-passing positive query may become failing on exposed R6v1/v2 and R3 diagnostic sets. Report aggregate and per-case regressions.
protocol.evaluation: Commit questions, gold and policy before reading candidate implementation or running either version. One run per pinned revision; no sweep, relabel or post-result threshold change.
protocol.comparison_unit: Each pinned RAG revision with its own official knowledge metadata; candidate changes code and knowledge metadata, not an isolated code-only experiment.
protocol.exposure_note: Candidate title/file list and issue discussion were seen; candidate implementation, new metadata contents and outputs were not. New wording overlaps known intents/corpus; paired translations are correlated, not48 independent users.
